# KoalaGitHub (github.koalastuff.net)

> KoalaGitHub is an open-source, privacy-first web application that aggregates, previews, and compares GitHub profile README visualizers, contribution graphs, streak stats, and bonsai trees.

## Core Features
- Live interactive previews for any GitHub username (default: Shik3i)
- Direct open-source repository link for every visualizer
- Customizable themes (Dark, Light, Tokyo Night, Dracula, Cyberpunk, etc.)
- 1-click Markdown code copy snippets for profile READMEs
- Anonymous device-based upvoting system
- Zero analytics, zero cookies, 100% open source

## Supported Visualizer Categories & Projects
- **Kodama Bonsai Tree**: Draws contribution history as a growing SVG bonsai tree (https://github.com/orijitghosh/kodama).
- **Contribution Grid Snake**: Snake animation eating contribution dots (https://github.com/Platane/snk).
- **GitHub Readme Streak Stats**: Displays total contributions, current streak, and longest streak (https://github.com/denvercoder1/github-readme-streak-stats).
- **GitHub Readme Activity Graph**: Contribution trend line graph (https://github.com/ashutosh00710/github-readme-activity-graph).
- **Arcade Pac-Man Graph**: Arcade Pac-Man & Breakout contribution graph (https://github.com/abozanona/pacman-contribution-graph).
- **GitHub Breakout Animation**: Bouncing Breakout game board (https://github.com/cyprieng/github-breakout).
- **Contribution Crawl**: 16-bit retro dungeon crawler (https://github.com/MaskiCoding/Contribution-Crawl).
- **3D Isometric Calendar**: Daily updated 3D contribution calendar (https://github.com/yoshi389111/github-profile-3d-contrib).
- **Profile Summary Cards**: Comprehensive overview & productive time cards (https://github.com/vn7n24fzkq/github-profile-summary-cards).
- **Capsule Render Headers**: SVG wave headers (https://github.com/kylelobo/The-Documentation-Compendium).
- **Profile Views Counter**: Dynamic visitor counter badge (https://github.com/antonkomarev/github-profile-views-counter).

## REST API Reference
- `GET https://github.koalastuff.net/api/visualizers` : Returns JSON list of all visualizers with vote counts.
- `GET https://github.koalastuff.net/api/health` : Server health status.
- `POST https://github.koalastuff.net/api/visualizers/{id}/vote` : Toggles upvote for a visualizer using a client UUID.
